name: clipboard
description: Read the current clipboard text, or write new text to the clipboard so the user can paste it elsewhere. Use when the user asks you to copy something (an answer, a snippet, a number, a URL) or to read what they have copied.

action.description: 'read' returns the current clipboard text; 'set' copies the provided text to the clipboard

text.description: The text to copy to the clipboard (only used with action 'set')
